1 image pushed to ECR (:latest)
2 EventBridge starts CodePipeline
3 CodeDeploy takes taskdef + appspec
4 blue/green cutover on the ALB

Five subnet tiers, two AZs
ALB · ECS · RDS Proxy · RDS · cache
each with its own security group,
so a compromise in one tier cannot
reach another except on one port.

No NAT gateway
Private subnets have no default
route. AWS APIs are reached over
6 interface endpoints, and S3
(ECR layers) over a gateway
endpoint.

Credentials
RDS generates and rotates the
master password in Secrets
Manager. No password appears in
a template or a task definition.

Auto scaling
1 to 4 tasks, CPU target 60%." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="396" width="210" x="32" y="726" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="title" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=17;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#232F3E;" value="todo-app-dev — ECS Fargate, RDS Proxy and ElastiCache for Redis in eu-west-1" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="34" width="900" x="290" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
Release path
1 image pushed to ECR (:latest)
2 EventBridge starts CodePipeline
3 CodeDeploy takes taskdef + appspec
4 blue/green cutover on the ALB
Five subnet tiers, two AZs
ALB · ECS · RDS Proxy · RDS · cache
each with its own security group,
so a compromise in one tier cannot
reach another except on one port.
No NAT gateway
Private subnets have no default
route. AWS APIs are reached over
6 interface endpoints, and S3
(ECR layers) over a gateway
endpoint.
Credentials
RDS generates and rotates the
master password in Secrets
Manager. No password appears in
a template or a task definition.
Auto scaling
1 to 4 tasks, CPU target 60%.
